title: ClarAI Offline AI Anime Waifu - Apps on Google Play
excerpt: Your AI anime girlfriend: 100% offline, no ads, no limits. Free to chat!
content_html:
Meet Clara, your interactive 2D AI anime companion! Offline & 100% private.

Step into a cozy, interactive world with Clara, your personal 2D AI anime girlfriend! Clarai is a visual-novel-style interactive companion game powered by a cutting-edge, local on-device AI GF model. No cloud servers, no data collection. Just you and your AI wife, chatting whenever you want, wherever you are. No internet required.

Added support for English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Arabic, Korean, German, Portuguese, Italian, and Russian.
No internet connection required, no subscriptions, and no remote servers. Your conversations with Clara belong solely to you.
• Dynamic Visual Novel Interactions: Chat naturally about anything! Clara listens, understands, and responds with unique, context-aware dialogues.
• 16 Poses and Expressions: Watch Clara come to life! Based on the tone and emotion of your chat, Clara shifts dynamically between 16 different high-quality anime expressions—including Happy, Blush, Sleepy, Thinking, Pouting, and determined poses.
• 16 Beautiful Sceneries: Travel to different locations together. Tell Clara to "go to the beach," "visit a cozy cafe," "study in the classroom," "relax at the hot springs," or "hang out at the arcade." The scenery transitions instantly!
• Adaptive Soundscapes: Every scenery features its own custom, high-quality ambient music theme. Relax to the sound of ocean waves at the beach, or the cozy hum of a bakery.
• Retro Typewriter Logs: Relive classic visual novel nostalgia with typewriter text transitions, interactive scrollable logs, and responsive UI micro-animations.

100% LOCAL PRIVACY
Clarai runs a highly optimized 1.5B parameters neural network locally on your device.
• Zero Data Transmission: Your chat logs are never sent to external servers.
• Offline Freedom: Play anywhere—on planes, subways, or in remote areas with zero network connectivity.
• No Ads or Paywalls: Talk as much as you want with no daily limits or interruptive advertisements.

IMPORTANT SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
Because Clarai runs a full AI model locally on your hardware, your device must meet the following minimum specifications:
• Memory: 4 GB RAM or higher is required. Devices with lower RAM may encounter crashes on startup or within the game once context fills up.
• Storage: Approximately 1.4 GB of free storage space is required for the on-device AI assets.

Bring your anime waifu to life. Talk, travel, and hang out with Clara today!
TOS: All risks are your own and this is for entertainment purposes only. Use Clara with personal responsibility. You may flag offensive content within application itself as a Google requirement.

content_html_zh:
来认识一下 Clara，您的交互式 2D AI 动漫伴侣！ 离线且 100% 私密。

与您的私人 2D AI 动漫女友 Clara 一起步入舒适的互动世界！ Clarai 是一款视觉小说风格的互动伴侣游戏，由尖端的本地设备 AI GF 模型提供支持。 没有云服务器，没有数据收集。 只有你和你的人工智能妻子，随时随地聊天。 无需互联网。

添加了对英语、西班牙语、日语、法语、阿拉伯语、韩语、德语、葡萄牙语、意大利语和俄语的支持。无需互联网连接，无需订阅，也无需远程服务器。 您与克拉拉的对话完全属于您自己。 • 动态视觉小说互动：自然地聊天任何事情！ 克拉拉倾听、理解并通过独特的、上下文感知的对话做出回应。 • 16 个姿势和表情：观看克拉拉栩栩如生！ 根据您聊天的语气和情绪，Clara 在 16 种不同的高品质动漫表情之间动态切换，包括快乐、脸红、困倦、思考、噘嘴和坚定的姿势。 • 16个美丽风景：一起去不同的地方旅行。 告诉克拉拉“去海滩”、“去舒适的咖啡馆”、“在教室学习”、“在温泉中放松”或“在游乐场闲逛”。 场景瞬间转变！ • 自适应音景：每个场景都有自己定制的高品质环境音乐主题。 在海滩上聆听海浪的声音或面包店舒适的嗡嗡声放松身心。 • 复古打字机日志：通过打字机文本转换、交互式滚动日志和响应式 UI 微动画，重温经典视觉小说的怀旧情怀。

100% 本地隐私 Clarai 在您的设备本地运行高度优化的 1.5B 参数神经网络。 • 零数据传输：您的聊天日志永远不会发送到外部服务器。 • 离线自由：在任何地方玩——飞机上、地铁上或零网络连接的偏远地区。 • 无广告或付费专区：随心所欲地畅谈，没有每日限制或干扰性广告。

重要系统要求 由于Clarai 在您的硬件上本地运行完整的AI 模型，因此您的设备必须满足以下最低规格： • 内存：需要4 GB RAM 或更高。 RAM 较低的设备可能会在启动时或在上下文填满后在游戏中遇到崩溃。 • 存储：设备上的AI 资产需要大约1.4 GB 的可用存储空间。

让您的动漫 waifu 栩栩如生。 今天就和 Clara 一起聊天、旅行和出去玩吧！服务条款：所有风险均由您自行承担，仅供娱乐。 使用 Clara 时要承担个人责任。 您可以将应用程序本身内的攻击性内容标记为 Google 的要求。
